20391.ins: Two pieces keeps this in the easy-wear tier - hair band and outfit, on in seconds, machine-gentle in a bag. The deep-V neckline does the design work that fuller maid sets assign to aprons and accessories, and the black-white scheme is the genre default.
20391.short: French maid cosplay set with hair band and deep-V outfit in classic black and white, one size for 40-65 kg, polyester.

20402.ins: The plush tail is structured rather than floppy, which is the detail that decides whether a cat costume photographs well or sags - and it arrives sewn to the jumpsuit rather than clipped. Two combos and two colorways at order time.
20402.short: Plush cat girl costume with headwear, jumpsuit, structured plush tail and hand sleeves in golden or red, one size for 40-60 kg.

20424.ins: Halterneck framing is the design - it draws the shoulders into the silhouette the way strapless versions cannot, and the neck ring echoes the line. Pink or black lace in the same four-piece construction, one size for 40-60 kg.
20424.short: Halterneck lace bunny one-piece with headband, neck ring and leg ring in pink or black, four pieces, one size for 40-60 kg.

20486.ins: Socks arriving in the set is the convenience most listings skip - matched hosiery is a separate hunt by default. The belly-pocket silhouette frames the midriff rather than covering it, and the printed bust and waist ranges back the one-size claim.
20486.short: Black belly-pocket maid set with jumpsuit, headband, bracelets and socks, five pieces, one size for 40-60 kg.

20493.ins: Three pieces is the honest minimum for a maid read - headwear to identify, skirt for the silhouette, underwear to complete - and sheer polyester keeps everything in lingerie weight. As-pictured colorway throughout the set.
20493.short: Three-piece sheer maid uniform with headwear, underwear and skirt in lingerie-weight polyester, one size for 40-60 kg.

20533.ins: The tube-top format suits wearers who prefer a skirt line to a legsuit - same bunny references, different silhouette below the waist. Five pieces in pink or red, with the sleeves balancing the strapless top against the rest.
20533.short: Bunny girl tube-top dress set with headband, neck ring, sleeves and thong in pink or red, five pieces, one size for 40-60 kg.

20544.ins: The openwork panel does what a print would otherwise do - carries the design in the fabric itself - and chiffon holds cutout edges without fraying concerns. Two pieces with the headgear included, as-pictured colorway throughout.
20544.short: Chiffon openwork-chest jumpsuit with matching headgear, two pieces, one size for 40-60 kg, as pictured costume set.

20551.ins: Milk silk is the fabric upgrade that justifies choosing this over the polyester student sets - the hand-feel difference is immediate and it survives washing without pilling. Blue is the only colorway, and it is the right one for the reference.
20551.short: Blue milk-silk student outfit with top and thong, one size for 40-60 kg, softest fabric in the student costume category.

20556.ins: The 40-70 kg range is the widest student-set claim on the site, and the oversized top is what makes it honest - the fit forgives where fitted tops would not. Black only, which keeps the set in the sleek register rather than plaid nostalgia.
20556.short: Black student miniskirt set with oversized top, one size for 40-70 kg, two-piece polyester costume with widest weight range.

20578.ins: The bow collar is the costume's identification and its only structural demand - a rope tie that adjusts to the wearer rather than the reverse. Sheer polyester keeps the shirt-and-skirt format in lingerie territory despite its office silhouette.
20578.short: Sheer student shirt with rope-tie bow collar and skirt in JK styling, one size for 40-60 kg, two pieces as pictured.
